description: Publish a compared template as an official HyperCodeMotion Studio gallery template once its comparison with the original looks faithful. Takes the tracking code, the moderator code and notes on what is consciously different from the original and why. Its gallery videos are rendered and the template is committed to the Studio code on its own branch, with a pull request whose preview shows it in the gallery: a moderator approves (merges) or discards it there. get_proposal_status gives the pull request link.

adminCode.description: The moderator code the user gave with the link. Required: only moderators can make gallery templates. Never repeat it back.

notes.description: Up to 600 characters: what is consciously different from the original and why, or that nothing is.

name: publish_template
title: Publish a gallery template
